notes.title: New Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
This patch introduces a host of QoL updates and WORLD LEADERBOARDS. You will now be able to see where you rank amongst other players for any game type and team size! Whenever you save a new highscore, your highest score will always be saved to the leaderboards to see where your best rank is at.

Let the arcade competition begin!

notes.title: Added achievements and UI updates
notes.notes: This patch introduces Steam Achievements, which are tied to the Special Feats. The game will also have some updated UI for Claw PANIC and the Private Arcade Room.

notes.title: Asteroid PANIC shield-charge indicator
notes.notes:
A lot of new changes and good updates and been implemented recently. This patch addresses just a few more:
[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes
[*] QoL features for menu system and music transitions
[*] Asteroid PANIC now has UI to show each player's shield-charge to it's easier to predict and use strategically.
[/list]

notes.title: Added "Special Feats" ticket rewards!
notes.notes: Added a new feature called "Special Feats" (similar to Achievements) that can be found in the Space Junk menu. Special Feats are tracked as you play, and they unlock to grant you bonus Tickets to spend in the Prize Store. This should make it easier to get more tickets and unlock more goodies for the Private Arcade!

notes.title: More support for more controllers!
notes.notes: Added more support for more controllers.

notes.title: Bug fixes and QoL updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Updated PARTY MODE to grant tickets for the Prize Store. This way you can play any way you like and still earn those tickets!
[*] Minor menu fixes / updates
[*] Fixed D-Pad input bugs with PS5 controllers.
[*] Fixed Defense Panic bug in multiplayer where shield graphics would continue to display after a player was eliminated.
[*] Fixed platformer controls bug when visiting Private Arcade after playing Run PANIC.
[*] Updated Drone AI targeting in Asteroid PANIC multiplayer.
[*] Updated the wormhole mechanics in the unlockable game type "Portal ZEN". (Unlocked by purchasing a Bean Bag style bed in the Prize Store)
[/list]
